cases.title: Select Available Seat and Update Count
cases.description: Click on an available seat without the occupied class to mark it as selected and verify that the selected seat count updates in the element with data-testid="selected-count".

cases.title: Select Movie and Calculate Total Price
cases.description: Select a movie from the dropdown with data-testid="movie-select" and verify that the total price shown in the element with data-testid="total-price" is correctly calculated as the number of selected seats multiplied by the selected movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent Selection of Occupied Seats
cases.description: Attempt to click on a seat marked as occupied and verify that it is not selectable and does not affect the selected count or total price.

cases.title: Update Total Price on Movie Change
cases.description: Change the selected movie from the dropdown after seats have been selected and verify that the total price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Select movie from dropdown
cases.description: Users can select a movie from the dropdown menu, and its price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Toggle and store available seat selection
cases.description: Clicking on an available seat toggles its selection status, visually marks it, and stores its index in localStorage.

cases.title: Deselect previously selected seat
cases.description: Users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, updating the UI and localStorage accordingly.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Seats marked as occupied cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Restore selected seats and movie from localStorage on load
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage when local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the system marks corresponding seats with the 'selected' class and sets the movie dropdown to the stored movie index.

cases.title: Default to no selected seats and first movie when localStorage is empty
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the dropdown defaults to the first movie option, 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Set ticket price from movie dropdown selection
cases.description: Verify that when the user selects a movie from the dropdown menu with data-testid 'movie-select', the ticket price is set according to the selected movie's value.

cases.title: Toggle selected class and update count and total price on available seat click
cases.description: Verify that clicking on available seats (those without the 'occupied' class) toggles the 'selected' class on the clicked seat, updates the selected seat count (data-testid 'selected-count'), and calculates the total price (data-testid 'total-price') as the product of the number of selected seats and the current ticket price.

cases.title: Decrease count and total price on seat deselection
cases.description: Verify that if a user deselects a seat by clicking on it again, the count and total price decrease accordingly.

cases.title: Update total price when changing movie after seat selection
cases.description: Verify that if the user changes the movie selection after selecting seats, the total price updates based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked as 'occupied'.

cases.title: Distinguish Seat States via Legends
cases.description: Verify that legends indicating the status of each seat, including data-testid='seat-select', are present to help users distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seats.

cases.title: Non-Interactive Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that occupied seats are clearly marked and non-interactive to prevent selection.

cases.title: Click Available Seats to Toggle Selection
cases.description: Verify that available seats can be clicked to toggle their selection status.

cases.title: Update Count and Total Price on Seat Selection and Deselection
cases.description: Verify that when users select or deselect seats, the count of selected seats and the total price are updated accordingly.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicit behaviors are fully and accurately covered by the provided test cases. No blockers or missing scenario gaps found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 defines multiple distinct behaviors: interacting with the seat map to select available seats, updating the selected seat count in data-testid="selected-count", selecting a movie from data-testid="movie-select", calculating the total price in data-testid="total-price" as selected seats multiplied by ticket price, restricting selection on occupied seats, and updating the total price on changing the movie. Explicit edge/boundary/abnormal conditions: occupied seats must not be selectable and must not affect count or price. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 outlines multiple distinct behaviors: selecting a movie from a dropdown with specific options and data-testids, updating ticket price upon movie selection, clicking an available seat to toggle selection, visually marking selected seats, storing selected seat indices in localStorage, dynamically updating seat count and total price, preventing selection/calculation of occupied seats, deselecting previously selected seats by clicking again, and updating UI and localStorage accordingly. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 describes retrieving and applying previously selected seats and movie selection from localStorage upon loading, marking corresponding seats with the 'selected' class if keys exist, setting the movie dropdown corresponding to 'selectedMovieIndex', and defaulting to no selected seats and the first movie option if localStorage lacks these values. Explicit boundary/edge cases: presence vs absence of 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' in localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 details multiple distinct behaviors: dynamically displaying selected seat count and total price, setting ticket price from data-testid 'movie-select', toggling 'selected' class on available seat clicks, updating 'selected-count', calculating 'total-price' as the product of selected seats and ticket price, decreasing count and total price on deselecting a seat, updating total price while maintaining seat count when movie changes after seat selection, and preventing selection of 'occupied' seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 outlines distinguishing seat states via legends (e.g., data-testid = 'seat-select'), non-interactive occupied seats preventing selection, clicking available seats to toggle selection, and updating count and total price on seat selection/deselection.
